q1fy27Call: Segments re-cut from Q1FY27: Living Essentials (salt, bicarb, prebiotics; India, UK, Singapore), Industrial Essentials (soda ash, silica, bromine/chlorine/caustic; India, US, Kenya, South Africa), Farm Essentials (Rallis + IMACID JV).

Soda ash: near-term outlook 'challenging' on Chinese oversupply; China inventories at an all-time high of 1.73 mt; Chinese export prices US$160-180/t FOB (US$170-190 CIF South-East Asia); 'USD 170 was the bottom', most Chinese producers losing money on a cash basis.

US: exports to South-East Asia 'just at breakeven level or unremunerative ... likely to remain so at least through the year'; US players have 'more or less vacated' SE Asia to China; domestic US stable, logistics costs rising.

India: Q1 EBITDA margin 28% helped by volumes, a ~Rs2,000/t soda ash spot price increase (import parity, weaker rupee) and low-cost coal inventory; sustainable margin 'around 18%'; coal and limestone costs could rise if the Middle East conflict runs beyond October.
UK: one-offs of ~GBP2.4 mn (EU ETS sale loss, prior-period items); expected EBITDA positive and PBT break-even for FY27.
Kenya: margins hit by HFO fuel prices; hedged up to October.
Capex: annualised around depreciation (~Rs1,200 cr, CFO agreed FY26 consolidated depreciation is the FY27 marker); non-core land to be monetised from H2.
Net debt down ~Rs300 cr vs March from sale of land and some shares.
IMACID did not produce in Q1 on high sulphur prices; expected profitable for the year.
Projects: 82.5 KTPA IVSD salt at Mithapur operational by year-end, supplies from Q1FY28; 210 KTPA salt (Valinokkam) and 50 KTPA silica (Cuddalore) 24-month execution, operational during 2028.
Sodium-ion battery: first pack made, pilot testing 6-9 months, full-scale plant at least two years after; LFP recycling at Mithapur with no major capex.
q4fy26Call: FY27 capex ~Rs1,300 cr (mostly maintenance at Mithapur and US); net debt expected to stay near Mar-26 levels in FY27.
Soda ash capex only when the cycle turns. Supply: a ~800 kt Chinese plant stopped on a lapsed permit; one US producer with 1.36 mt mothballed; Solvay cut ~180 kt in Spain.
India: DGTR examining safeguard measures (quantity restrictions) on soda ash imports alongside anti-dumping.
Solar glass could add ~7,500-10,000 t a month of dense ash demand in India when new units run.

New projects: IVSD 82.5 KTPA Mithapur (Rs100 cr, Q1FY28), dense soda ash 350 KTPA Mithapur (Rs135 cr, Q3FY28, repurposes the cement plant), precipitated silica 50 KTPA Cuddalore (Rs775 cr, Q4FY28, 'under detailed review'), IVSD 210 KTPA Valinokkam (Rs515 cr, Q2FY29); target IRRs 15-20%+.
